## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 426 captures during May 2019. Activity proceeded in line with the planned session lists, apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results set out below. No further operational issue is noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the 426 captures, 11 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.6 per cent. The ungradable images could not be taken forward for grading. The result is reported as part of the routine site review and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for May 2019.

## Grading

The grading review identified 69 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 5 days. These figures summarise the grading position for West Gate Eye Clinic during May 2019. Together, the results show the volume reviewed, the proportion unavailable for grading, and the number assessed as referable. Session lists remained as planned apart from routine leave.
